lines: A collapsed supply bunker, partially buried under rock and soil. Someone dug it out — the tool marks are old.
Inside: the remains of a last camp. Bedrolls arranged in military formation. A field stove, long cold. Personal effects scattered on makeshift shelves.
A team photo is pinned to the wall — five faces, smiling in front of an outpost gate. Fen is on the far right, looking younger. Happier.
Whatever happened to this squad, they didn't die here. They set up camp, stashed their supplies, and went out one last time. Only Fen came back.
A military-grade Sol Unit frame — the Mk1+, with a 6x6 component grid. Significantly more powerful than your standard Mk1.
This was squad leader's equipment. Top-of-the-line when it was issued. Still is, really — nothing civilian-grade comes close.
Equip it to transfer your existing components to the larger grid.

actions.text: A military-spec battery housing. Combined with umbracite and copper coils at Yun's workshop, this could make a much more powerful rechargeable battery.

lines: A tactical visor from Fen's squad leader. The heads-up display still works — enemy silhouettes glow through darkness and thin cover.
Fen Maro in Meridian City would recognize this. It belonged to someone he served with.
